summary_md: **Eric D. Brown, D.Sc. ([@EricDBrownDsC](https://x.com/EricDBrownDsC/status/2115590715686150616))** covers Simular's **Agent S4 (Evolving Agent Interfaces)**, which evolves the interfaces a computer-use agent works through while the model stays fixed: Qwen3.8-27B scored 21.3% on OSWorld V2, 3.8x its fixed-interface score, at $1.10 per task.
relevance: Big computer-use gains for a local-class 27B model from interface evolution alone.
